lesson:
Set a timeout on every outbound HTTP call, so a slow service cannot hold the caller's workers.
When writing code that calls another service over HTTP.
Set a timeout on every outbound HTTP call.
A call with no timeout can wait as long as the other service takes.
Missing timeout can exhaust all worker threads causing complete service stop.
Python requests library has no default timeout.
Passing a tuple like (connect_timeout, read_timeout) bounds wait times.
